title: soc2-prep-scratchpad-priya-kapoor
content:
SOC2 prep scratchpad - Priya

Context / scope notes:
- Scope idea: Hosted API + Dedicated for 3 initial customers (SaaS + mid-market). Private deployments excluded for initial audit to limit scope.
- Include supporting services: auth, storage (S3), logging pipeline (ELK), key management (KMS).
- Exclude experimental infra (feature branches, dev-only clusters).

High-level gaps I think we have (brain dump):
1) Access reviews: we have AD groups and roles but need documented quarterly access review process for service accounts + GCP service accounts. Who signs off? 
   - Owner proposal: Oliver to own infra service accounts, Grace to own app service accounts.
   - Action: create JIRA RED-1305 for quarterly access review playbook.
2) Change management / PR approvals: engineering PRs have CI but not always two approvers for infra changes affecting security config. Need enforcement doc + automations.
   - Possible control: require 2 approvers for any terraform changes touching network/iam.
   - Action: add GitHub branch protection rule + update CONTRIBUTING.md (ticket RED-1310).
3) Logging retention & integrity: logs flow to ELK but retention varies. Need retention policy and proof (config + screenshots). Also need explanation of log pipeline and alerts.
   - Who: Noah to pull retention configs and create export.

Control mapping draft (working):
- CC: Security (logical) -> Controls: access provisioning, MFA, password policies, IAM reviews. Evidence: IAM audit logs, group membership lists, policy documents.
- CC: Change Management -> Controls: PR approvals, deploy runbooks, emergency change process. Evidence: PR history, runbooks in Confluence, postmortem templates.
- CC: Availability/Monitoring -> Controls: SLOs, alerting, oncall rota, incident response. Evidence: PagerDuty schedule, SLO dashboard screenshots, recent incident postmortems.
- CC: Data Protection -> Controls: encryption at rest/in transit, KMS usage, backups. Evidence: KMS configs, S3 bucket policies, backup job configs.

Risks & open questions to resolve with security leads:
- RQ1: Do we need to include Dedicated GPU clusters that are customer-specific in scope? (cost of expanding scope is large)
- RQ2: How far back do we need evidence for log retention (12 months vs 6 months)? Check auditor expectations.
- RQ3: Service account owner mapping: some older accounts have unclear owners. Need inventory + ownership assignment cadence.

Evidence checklist (initial):
- IAM: org policy screenshot, list of owner approvers, SSO config, 2FA enforcement claim.
- Change mgmt: example terraform PR touching network, branch protection screenshots, release notes.
- Monitoring: SLO dashboard snapshots, PagerDuty schedules, escalations policy doc.
- Backups & DR: backup job schedules, restore test notes (we have 1 restore test from 2024-06, need another).
- Vendor risk: contracts and encrypt-in-transit clauses for any third-party tooling (we need to compile a list).

Immediate TODOs (short term):
- [ ] Create RED ticket for quarterly access review (RED-1305) and assign owners (Oliver/Grace).
- [ ] Pull log retention configs and generate evidence pack (Noah).
- [ ] Draft change management addendum for infra PR process and branch protections (me + infra).
- [ ] Inventory service accounts and tag owners (working sheet).
- [ ] Confirm auditor evidence retention window (email auditor contact: audrey@audit-firm.com).

Meeting notes from sync 2026-02-18 with Oliver/Noah:
- Agreed: limit initial SOC2 scope to Hosted API + Dedicated; Private deployments deferred.
- Action: Oliver will draft a one-page scope statement for auditors by 2026-02-25.
- Noah: will produce a log retention export and list of centralized indices by 2026-03-05.

Unresolved/friction points:
- Some infra terraform state is split across multiple backends which complicates evidence gathering. Might need a short audit script to enumerate affected resources.
- Ownership culture: engineers sometimes rotate teams and do not update owner tags. Need small automation to remind owners to confirm.

Notes to self (reminders):
- Keep artifacts simple: auditors like screenshots + singular canonical config files (less explanation, more evidence).
- When in doubt, short runbook + screenshot beats long narrative.
- Save workspace links in a single confluence page and reference from evidence zip.

Links / references (to collect into evidence page):
- Confluence SOC2 prep page: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SOC2/SOC2+Prep
- Infra PR example: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/678
- Jira: RED-1243 (audit kickoff), RED-1305 (access review), RED-1310 (branch protection)
- Slack thread for SOC2 sync: https://slack.com/archives/C12345678/p1670000000

Next steps for me (Priya):
- Draft scope statement and share with legal and Oliver by Feb 25.
- Consolidate evidence checklist into a Google Drive folder and start dropping artifacts there (use naming convention: soc2_evidence/<control>-<artifact>-YYYYMMDD).
- Schedule weekly 30m sync for the next 8 weeks with owners (Oliver/Noah/Grace).

Misc shorthand notes (might transcribe to Confluence later):
- Audit firm prefers CSV inventories for service accounts.
- Keep restore test notes short: date, person, steps, result.

=== end scratchpad ===
